user_agents.name: OAI-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface websites in search results in ChatGPT's search features
user_agents.scope: Crawls web content to index for ChatGPT search results; opted-out sites won't appear in search answers

user_agents.name: GPTBot
user_agents.purpose: Train generative AI foundation models with crawled content
user_agents.scope: Crawls content for training OpenAI's generative AI models; automatic web crawling
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: GPTBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; disallow indicates content should not be used for training

user_agents.name: OAI-AdsBot
user_agents.purpose: Validate safety of web pages submitted as ChatGPT ads
user_agents.scope: Visits only landing pages submitted as ads; checks policy compliance and relevance for ad targeting
user_agents.opt_out: Not documented; data not used for training AI models

user_agents.name: ChatGPT-User
user_agents.purpose: Handle user-triggered actions in ChatGPT and Custom GPTs
user_agents.scope: User-initiated page visits for answers and GPT Actions; not automatic crawling; robots.txt may not apply
user_agents.opt_out: Not applicable to robots.txt; user-triggered requests may bypass standard crawl rules

user_agents.name: ClaudeBot
user_agents.purpose: Collect web content for AI model training and development
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for training data collection
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt; also supports Crawl-delay directive

user_agents.name: Claude-User
user_agents.purpose: Support Claude AI users by retrieving web content in response to user queries
user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live responses to Claude user questions
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-User / Disallow: / in robots.txt to prevent retrieval

user_agents.name: Claude-SearchBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawl web to improve search result quality and relevance for users
user_agents.scope: Search indexing and optimization for user-directed web search
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Claude-SearchBot / Disallow: / in robots.txt to prevent indexing

user_agents.name: Googlebot
user_agents.purpose: Building Google Search indexes and finding information
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for Google Search, Discover, Images, Video, News

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Image
user_agents.purpose: Crawling images for Google Images and search features
user_agents.scope: Image-specific crawling for Google Images, Discover, Video, Search logos and favicons

user_agents.name: Googlebot-Video

user_agents.scope: Video-specific crawling for Google Search video features and dependent products

user_agents.name: Googlebot-News
user_agents.purpose: Crawling content for Google News product
user_agents.scope: News content for Google News product, news.google.com, and Google News app

user_agents.name: Storebot-Google

user_agents.scope: Product data for Google Shopping, Shopping tab in Search, and Google Shopping

user_agents.name: Google-InspectionTool
user_agents.purpose: Testing and validation for Search Console tools

user_agents.name: GoogleOther
user_agents.purpose: Generic crawling for various product teams and R&D
user_agents.scope: Generic publicly accessible content for internal research and product teams

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Image
user_agents.purpose: Generic image crawling for various products and R&D
user_agents.scope: Generic image URL fetching for internal research and product teams

user_agents.name: GoogleOther-Video
user_agents.purpose: Generic video crawling for various products and R&D
user_agents.scope: Generic video URL fetching for internal research and product teams

user_agents.name: Google-CloudVertexBot
user_agents.purpose: Crawling for building Vertex AI Agents
user_agents.scope: Site owner-requested crawls for Vertex AI Agents construction

user_agents.name: Google-Extended

user_agents.scope: Content for Gemini Apps, Vertex AI API for Gemini, and grounding with Google Search
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Google-Extended / Disallow: / in robots.txt; does not impact Google Search ranking

user_agents.name: PerplexityBot
user_agents.purpose: Surface and link websites in search results on Perplexity
user_agents.scope: Search result indexing; does not crawl for AI training data

user_agents.name: Perplexity-User
user_agents.purpose: Support user-triggered actions within Perplexity
user_agents.scope: Fetches web pages on-demand when users ask questions; generally ignores robots.txt
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Perplexity-User / Disallow: / in robots.txt (though this user-triggered fetcher may override)

user_agents.name: Applebot
user_agents.purpose: Powers search features in Spotlight, Siri, and Safari across Apple ecosystem
user_agents.scope: General web crawling for search indexing and content discovery
user_agents.opt_out: Disallow Applebot in robots.txt; respects standard robots.txt directives and Googlebot rules if Applebot-specific rules absent

user_agents.name: Applebot-Extended
user_agents.purpose: Determines usage of crawled content for training Apple foundation models powering generative AI features
user_agents.scope: Does not crawl webpages; processes data from Applebot crawls to control AI training usage
user_agents.opt_out: User-agent: Applebot-Extended / Disallow: / in robots.txt to opt-out of generative AI training

user_agents.name: iTMS
user_agents.purpose: Crawls URLs associated with registered content on Apple Podcasts
user_agents.scope: Apple Podcasts content only; does not follow robots.txt directives
user_agents.opt_out: Does not respect robots.txt; contact Apple for iTunes/Podcasts-specific control

user_agents.name: FacebookExternalHit
user_agents.purpose: Crawl shared content on Meta family of apps to gather title, description, thumbnail
user_agents.scope: Content shared on Facebook, Instagram, Messenger via links or social plugins
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: facebookexternalhit / Disallow: / to robots.txt; may bypass for security checks

user_agents.name: Meta-WebIndexer
user_agents.purpose: Improve Meta AI search result quality and relevance
user_agents.scope: General web crawl to enhance Meta AI capabilities
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: meta-webindexer / Disallow: / to robots.txt

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAds
user_agents.purpose: Improve advertising and other business-related products and services
user_agents.scope: Web crawl for advertising and business use cases
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: meta-externalads / Disallow: / to robots.txt

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalAgent
user_agents.purpose: Train foundation AI models and improve products by indexing content
user_agents.scope: Web crawl for AI model training and product improvement
user_agents.opt_out: Add User-agent: meta-externalagent / Disallow: / to robots.txt

user_agents.name: Meta-ExternalFetcher

user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetches to help AI navigate websites and complete tasks
user_agents.opt_out: May bypass robots.txt as performs user-requested fetches; no standard opt-out

user_agents.name: MicrosoftPreview

user_agents.scope: Crawls content for preview generation in Microsoft products

user_agents.name: BingBot

user_agents.scope: General web crawl for Bing search engine

user_agents.name: Amazonbot
user_agents.purpose: Improve products and services; train Amazon AI models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for product improvement and AI model training

user_agents.purpose: Improve search experiences in Amazon products and services

user_agents.name: Amzn-User

user_agents.scope: User-triggered fetch for live responses; excludes generative AI training

user_agents.name: CCBot/2.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for Common Crawl dataset collection
user_agents.scope: General web crawl, respects robots.txt and crawl-delay directives

user_agents.name: CCBot/1.0
user_agents.purpose: Web crawling for Common Crawl dataset collection (older version)
user_agents.scope: General web crawl, respects robots.txt and crawl-delay directives

user_agents.name: AI Crawlers (General)
user_agents.purpose: Training data collection and content indexing for AI models
user_agents.scope: General web crawl for AI training datasets and agent interactions
user_agents.opt_out: HTTP 402 Payment Required responses; Pay-per-Crawl feature via Cloudflare; robots.txt Disallow directives

user_agents.name: Agentic Actors
user_agents.purpose: Autonomous AI agents executing tasks and queries on web content
user_agents.scope: User-triggered and scheduled automated interactions; represented ~10% of network traffic as of March 2026
user_agents.opt_out: Agent Readiness Score and Redirects for AI Training features; robots.txt-based blocking

user_agents.name: AI Bots (Malicious)
user_agents.purpose: Unauthorized content scraping, login attacks, fraud, and data theft
user_agents.scope: Adversarial crawling and bot traffic mimicking human behavior; significant portion of automated traffic
user_agents.opt_out: Bot management, application security controls, and HTTP 402 Payment Required mechanisms
